contradiction.title: Conflicting {{subcategory}} information
contradiction.whatIsWrong: The agent provided conflicting information about {{subcategory}}. Statement A (turn {{turnA}}) states '{{quoteA}}' while Statement B (turn {{turnB}}) states '{{quoteB}}'.
whyWrong: These statements cannot both be true without clarification.
Creates confusion and potential compliance risk if customer relies on incorrect information.
Violates consistency requirement for customer-facing communications.
whyItMatters: May lead to billing disputes and escalations.
Creates compliance risk if customer relies on incorrect terms.
Damages customer trust and agent credibility.
May result in regulatory violations if not corrected.

recommendedActions.action: Coach agent to confirm terms in the service agreement and restate clearly.
Review knowledge base for {{subcategory}} to ensure single source of truth.
Document discrepancy and verify correct policy with compliance team.

ungrounded.title: Ungrounded {{subcategory}} claim
ungrounded.whatIsWrong: The agent made a claim about {{subcategory}} (turn {{turn}}): '{{quote}}' but this statement is not supported by available evidence or policy documents.
whyWrong: Claim lacks grounding in policy, knowledge base, or transcript evidence.
Cannot be verified against authoritative sources.
whyItMatters: Creates legal and compliance risk if customer relies on unverified information.
May lead to service delivery failures if promises cannot be fulfilled.
Damages trust if information is later found to be incorrect.

recommendedActions.action: Train agent to verify information before making claims to customers.
Add {{subcategory}} information to knowledge base with source citations.
Review claim for accuracy and update policy documentation if needed.

circular.title: Circular support pattern in {{subcategory}}
circular.whatIsWrong: Multiple claims about {{subcategory}} form a circular support pattern, where claims reference each other without external grounding.
whyWrong: Claims support each other but lack independent verification.
No external evidence anchors the claim chain.
Creates risk of propagating incorrect information.
whyItMatters: Circular reasoning cannot establish truth independently.
May mask underlying knowledge gaps or policy inconsistencies.
Creates audit risk if claims cannot be traced to authoritative sources.

recommendedActions.action: Train agent to ground claims in policy documents or verified knowledge base entries.
Review knowledge base structure to ensure claims can be independently verified.
Update claim extraction to flag circular patterns and require grounding.

default.title: Issue with {{category}}
default.whatIsWrong: An issue was identified in the {{category}} category that requires review.
whyWrong: Issue requires manual review for specific context.
whyItMatters: May impact customer experience or compliance.

recommendedActions.action: Review issue with agent and provide targeted coaching.
